assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Right triangle with C at the right angle, CA = 3 horizontal and CB = 4 vertical; the blue circle on CA, the green circle on CB and the magenta circle on the hypotenuse AB as diameters, and the orange circle of radius 1 with centre O = (3, 2) beyond the hypotenuse, touching the magenta circle from inside and the blue and green circles from outside; dashed lines join O to the blue and green centres.

difficulty_rationale: Needs setting up the three tangency conditions and noticing that subtracting them gives linear equations.
